play.notifyInstall: On an iPhone, notifications need the game on your Home Screen: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, open the game from there, and tap 🔔 again.
play.notifyOn: You will be notified when it is your move.
play.notifyBlocked: Notifications are turned off for this site on this device, so the page cannot ask again. Turn them on in the device's settings, then reload and tap 🔔.

unblock.ios: On an iPhone: open the Settings app → Notifications → Twilight (the Home Screen app) → Allow Notifications. If Twilight is not listed, open the game from its Home Screen icon and tap 🔔 there.
unblock.android: On Android Chrome: tap the icon left of the address (or ⋮ → Settings → Site settings → Notifications), find dustinheestand.github.io and choose Allow. For the installed app: long-press its icon → App info → Notifications.
unblock.desktop: In the browser: click the icon left of the address → Notifications → Allow (Chrome: Settings → Privacy and security → Site settings → Notifications).
